title: The year is 2026. You can create an multiplayer Minecraft inspired shooter with 5 maps, 12 weapons, voice lines and SFX in under 2 hours. We live in the future.
author: cody-fifth-door

comments.author: cody-fifth-door
comments.body:
Done entirely through Claude Code with Opus 5. Use an Eleven Labs key for the SFX/voice lines. Server hosted on [fly.io](http://fly.io) and client on [fifthdoor.com](http://fifthdoor.com)   
  
All under 2 hours. The future is really crazy. What's going to be possible in 5 years?  
  
Play it here: [https://play.fifthdoor.com/play/blockfare?referrer=discover](https://play.fifthdoor.com/play/blockfare?referrer=discover)
